description: Defines interfaces and data structures for managing Closed Captions styles, TTML styles, and TextTrack sessions in a media framework, including methods for session control, style application, and notifications.

classes.name: ITextTrackClosedCaptionsStyle
classes.description: Interface for managing Closed Captions styles, including setting styles, registering notifications, and handling style change events.

classes.name: ITextTrackTtmlStyle
classes.description: Interface for managing global TTML style overrides, including setting and retrieving style override strings.

classes.name: ITextTrack
classes.description: Interface for handling TextTrack sessions, including opening, closing, resetting sessions, sending data, and changing modes.

methods.name: SetClosedCaptionsStyle
methods.description: Sets the ClosedCaptionsStyle for captions rendering.

methods.name: GetClosedCaptionsStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the current ClosedCaptionsStyle settings.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for style change events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: SetTtmlStyleOverrides
methods.description: Sets global TTML style overrides.

methods.name: GetTtmlStyleOverrides
methods.description: Retrieves current global TTML style overrides.

methods.name: OpenSession
methods.description: Opens a new TextTrack session.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Closes an existing TextTrack session.

methods.name: ResetSession
methods.description: Resets a session to its initial state.

methods.name: PauseSession
methods.description: Pauses a session.

methods.name: ResumeSession
methods.description: Resumes a paused session.

methods.name: MuteSession
methods.description: Hides captions in a session.

methods.name: UnMuteSession
methods.description: Unhides captions in a session.

methods.name: SendSessionData
methods.description: Sends caption or timed text data to a session.

methods.name: SendSessionTimestamp
methods.description: Sends a media timestamp to a session.

methods.name: ApplyCustomClosedCaptionsStyleToSession
methods.description: Applies a custom style to a specific session.

methods.name: SetPreviewText
methods.description: Sets static preview text in a session.

methods.name: SetSessionClosedCaptionsService
methods.description: Sets the CC service for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionTeletextSelection
methods.description: Sets Teletext mode and page for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionDvbSubtitleSelection
methods.description: Sets DVB Subtitle mode and page for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionWebVTTSelection
methods.description: Sets WebVTT mode for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionTTMLSelection
methods.description: Sets TTML mode for a session.

methods.name: SetSessionSCTESelection
methods.description: Sets SCTE mode for a session.

methods.name: ApplyCustomTtmlStyleOverridesToSession
methods.description: Overrides TTML styles for a session.

methods.name: AssociateVideoDecoder
methods.description: Associates a video decoder handle with a session for caption data.
